selection: Same fixed top-32 policy as the 4K validation, now 32/512 blocks at the end; more aggressive sparsity, no tuning on this run
quality: 512 natural-target samples in the second half, stride 32; up to 64 dense teacher-forced continuation tokens
profiling: One extra aligned 256-token batch after timed prefill/decode, after alignment padding. Vulkan timestamps serialize operations; diagnostic batch is excluded from main prefill/decode timings.
limitations: One timed pass per mode, one previously used code passage, scored rather than ordinary prefill, no task benchmark or equivalence claim
